description.value:
Aspect The Many

Cost Focus 1

Choose one: your reach increases by 5 feet until the end of your turn, or — if you're already taking an action that includes a Strike this turn — you gain one additional Strike as part of that action, using the same weapon or unarmed attack.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Extra reach, or an extra simultaneous Strike' -- no generic 'grant one additional Strike as part of this action' rule element exists (multi-attack grants in real pf2e are hand-coded system behavior, not data-only rule elements). No clean 'reach +5 until end of turn' modifier either: reach is a weapon-trait property altered via ItemAlteration on a specific weapon item, and this ability isn't tied to one.
